slot_note: Architecture 6 re-root. Architectures 1, 2 and 3 died on determinism verdicts; 4 on a model constraint plus a measured null; 5 (criminology-justice/crime-incidence-hotspot-analysis) died on measurement, eleven candidates on screens and the near-repeat Knox ratio on a repeat-address reflex. New ground: survey-research-official-statistics / anomaly-detection.
niche: a national environment statistics institute's plan-attainment review of business waste recovery, finding which of eight statistical waste streams the 2026 recovery share is established below its National Waste Management Plan target for, so the collection division can commit its single 2027 supplementary field module
stakeholder_role: the Head of Collection Operations in the Business and Environment Statistics Division of the National Institute for Environment Statistics, who runs the Business Waste Survey's collection round and holds the division's single supplementary field module for 2027, and must name the waste stream it covers

spine.entity: one leg of one waste consignment recorded in the national waste movement register
spine.grain: consignment x leg (producer despatch, interim receipt, interim forward, final receipt, treatment confirmation)

world.org_type: statutory national institute compiling the official waste statistics and running the Business Waste Survey

driver: The decisive quantity is a ratio whose numerator is a complete administrative total and whose denominator is an estimate from a stratified probability sample, so none of the ratio's error comes from the numerator and none from the units the design enumerated completely; the member whose denominator sits almost wholly among those enumerated units is the only one whose gap against a fixed published reference is established, while the member with the largest raw gap, the most sampled records and the largest totals has a gap well inside its own interval, so every route that reads precision off a record count, off an overall published precision figure, or off a design variance computed without the correction for complete enumeration names that member instead.
driver_concrete: Each waste stream's 2026 recovery share is the register's complete recovered tonnage over the Business Waste Survey's estimate of the stream's arisings, so the share's standard error is the arisings estimate's alone, and 93.7 per cent of metal arisings come from the 250-or-more employee stratum the survey enumerates completely and which therefore contributes no sampling error, giving metal a 1.3 per cent CV against mixed commercial and industrial waste's 7.2 per cent; metal's 2.0 point shortfall is 3.46 standard errors and mixed waste's 4.7 point shortfall is 1.30.
stump: A competent solver computes every stream's 2026 recovery share correctly, ranks the shortfalls against the plan targets or tests them with a record-count or published-national precision figure, and names mixed commercial and industrial wastes, whose shortfall is the largest in points and clears every such test; the design variance of the arisings estimate, with the completely enumerated stratum contributing nothing, leaves metal and metal-bearing wastes as the only stream established below target.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who has cleaned the register, chained the consignments to final treatment, read every definition and used the survey weights correctly still ranks the eight streams by the size of their shortfall against target, or tests each shortfall against the only precision figures to hand (the stream's sampled record count, or the published national CV of total arisings), and files mixed commercial and industrial wastes, measured at 4.7 points of shortfall against metal's 2.0.
domain_test: Design-based ratio estimation decides it: the share's variance is the linearised variance of its survey-estimated denominator, and in a stratified business survey the completely enumerated large-enterprise stratum carries a finite-population correction of zero, so a stream's precision is set by where its arisings sit in the design and not by how many records report it; swap the nouns into a world of complete records and there is no probability sample, no stratum, no inclusion fraction and no design variance, and the task stops existing.
layer1: register schema change at the mid-year boundary (renamed columns, revised operation-code list)
treatment operation codes revised mid-year with a published mapping
waste classification codes revised mid-year with a crosswalk
consignments routed through interim facilities, so the same tonnage appears on two legs
confirmation date against despatch date at the year boundary
tonnes against hundreds of kilograms in a legacy extract
agency permit number against business register enterprise number, with supersessions and duplicates
reference tables inside a published PDF

differentiation.task186: Same domain, subdomain and objective, and the only other build in this cell. task186's decisive step is the reference distribution a per-unit test needs, an empirical null built from between-period changes because unit levels cycle locally within a place; mine is which of a ratio's two terms, and which sampled units, carry sampling error at all. task186 has no probability sample, no design weights, no strata and no ratio estimator, and its world is posted fuel prices in a Canadian province; mine is a stratified business survey of waste arisings in Portugal.
differentiation.task195: task195's rung is the uncertainty of a paired difference between two screens applied to the same units, which is not the overlap of each screen's own interval. Mine is a ratio, not a difference, its two terms are not two measurements of the same units, and the decisive step is that one term carries no error whatever and that within the other the completely enumerated units carry none either; the covariance that decides task195 does not appear in my estimator at all.
differentiation.task191: task191's rigor step is selection on the maximum, judging the largest of many shortfalls against the largest a quiet set of the same size produces. Mine is not a max-selection: the bar is filed per stream at the 95 per cent level, exactly one stream clears it, and the call is measured to be unchanged under no correction, Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg, so multiplicity decides nothing here.
differentiation.task198: task198's spent architecture 2 (a measured difference between places produced by the few people who did the measuring, measurer collinear with place) and architecture 3 (uncertainty computed over replication groups while the error source acts on groups the record never replicates over) are both banned to this build and neither is reused: my error source is sampling error itself, correctly captured by every design-based instrument, and the question is which terms and which units contribute any of it. No replicate weights are shipped.
differentiation.client_pattern_2: The client's second anomaly-detection rigor pattern for this subdomain is the Hidiroglou-Berthelot robust ratio test, which scales a unit-level test of a ratio of two reported values by unit size and needs no sample design at all. Mine is domain-level and turns on which of a ratio's terms carries error. No size exponent, quartile bound, unit-level ratio test or editing threshold is filed anywhere in the pack.
differentiation.task228: task228's architecture 2 separates each unit's own measurement error from the error of its comparators by the pairwise covariances of three independent measurements of a signal nothing observes, and its finding is that two comparators sharing an input co-vary in one region. Mine has no comparator, no unobserved signal and no covariance separation: the error is sampling error under a stated probability design, it is known in form and estimated in size from the sample itself, and the decisive step is that part of that sample is a complete enumeration and so contributes none of it.
differentiation.task240: task240 is the nearest build in this domain by family: there the sampling error of a calibrated total is the spread of each unit's departure from its calibration cell's mean, so treating the scaled weights as fixed overstates the error for the quantities the cells explain. Mine involves no calibration, no cells and no GREG residual; the weights are fixed design weights, the quantity is a ratio whose numerator is a complete administrative total carrying no error at all, and the decisive fact is that the denominator is partly a census and partly a sample, so 93.7 per cent of the winning stream's arisings are known rather than estimated. task240's call is a reliability flag on an estimate; mine names which of eight streams is established below a plan target.
differentiation.task189: task189's decisive quantity is a per-unit average over measurements many of which are known only to lie below a limit that differs by the instrument that produced them, so its rigor step is how to treat left-censored values. Mine has no censoring and no limit of detection: every arisings value is reported in full, the zeros are real zeros, and the step is which of a ratio's terms and which sampled units carry sampling error.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4, three consecutive determinism SEND_BACK verdicts, Gate F moderate to low
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the stock of undetected cases a scarce reviewer would meet, which is each unit's arrival rate multiplied by how long a case goes unseen there, so ranking units by the cases they confirm ranks them by arrivals alone.

lineage.fate: spent after three judge passes, the third NOT_DETERMINISTIC on an averaging estimator the pack files nowhere
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many items were placed just under a threshold to stay under it, and the practice that placed them there leaves a matching shortfall just over the threshold, because the item each one replaced is not in the record any more.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4, NOT_DETERMINISTIC SEND_BACK; Gate B forced the reliability factor table to ship and shipping it made the projection route recoverable, so Gate F fell
lineage.driver: Items were drawn into the tested set with probability proportional to their size, so a tested item stands for a fixed amount of the population rather than for one item, and every item above that amount was certain to be drawn and stands only for itself.

lineage.fate: abandoned on a model constraint rather than a design finding (two builder sessions terminated by an API safeguard on the ground's subject matter), and separately measured dead in four parameterisations
lineage.driver: A detector setting is worth what each episode still has ahead of it when that setting's own alert fires, so the settings can only be compared by summing every episode's remaining volume at the firing time each setting itself produces.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 1 on measurement, nothing cut: eleven candidate decisive steps died on the WHAT screen, the swap test or the corpus, and the one that cleared both, a near-repeat clustering ratio against its own Knox pair margins, died because the plain share of addresses burgled more than once reaches the designed winner at every boost by a wider margin (1.50x to 2.89x) than the decisive step (1.26x to 1.46x)
lineage.driver: Burglaries falling close together in place and time more often than each area's own spatial and temporal pair margins imply rank the areas for a post-event response, against the raw close-pair count.

notes:
Reserved-axis deviations, with reasons: stump_strategy is uncertainty_hold rather than the reserved composition_mix, because no mix shift, standardisation or reweighting changes the comparison here and a reviewer would read the decisive move as how the evidence is judged with its uncertainty; the fingerprint rule is to use the reviewer's key rather than the passing one. calibration_form is none rather than the reserved closed_decision_corpus, because the method is forced by the sample design itself and a corpus would either bless a wrong method (the validated decoy the guard blocks) or tie only under the golden (an oracle). context_artifact is capacity_report rather than published_series, because task244 is in the last three and carries published_series, so ban.artifact blocks it; the division's collection capacity note is the file this role actually works from and carries no ranking of the streams. scoring_unit is other: the module is costed in field days and the call names a stream, so no listed unit is honest. Geography is Portugal rather than architecture 4's Finland, which this slot already spent along with three of its personas. role_family is operations_director rather than the reserved capacity_planner, after three probes. ban.role blocked capacity_planner against task197; the block appeared to lapse when the axis bans moved to the last three live cards and this slot's stale card went architecture_spent; and it fired again the moment this build's own card was put live in the window, because registering it pulls task197 back into the last three. An axis ban is not cleared by argument, so the axis is redrawn: this role runs the division's collection operation, which is what operations_director names, and the module commitment is still the forcing decision. If the window has moved again by registration, re-probe before registering. The gate_g WARNs stand answered in the design note: no other listed mechanism is honest for a call that turns on choosing the variance estimator for a design-based ratio. The decisive generator stays G16 (method selection), with G17 second. G17 was probed as an alternative because the surface screen promotes task190 against task195 on the gap, decisive generator and Gate G triple; G17 moved the promotion rather than removing it, to task189 and task191, which carry G17 and sit either side of this slot by number. Both labels are defensible and G16 is the one a reviewer reaches first given that gate_g is method_or_model_selection, so the label was not changed to clear a screen and the promoted pair is reported with its differentiation instead.
